title: Derived residue cohomology factors through an open
statement: For every scheme W, point w in an open U and integer i, the exact derived restriction to the localized module site of U followed by localDerivedFiberCohomologyFunctor is naturally isomorphic to derivedFiberCohomologyFunctor [new-derived-fiber-cohomology-functor]. No affinity or perfectness is assumed. The local functor uses the explicit residue-point factorization through U, the canonical over-site equivalence, derived pullback, homology and field-valued sections.

source.document: Stacks Project; Mathlib and the existing Lean library

proof.text: Factor the residue point through U using the inverse residue-field map of the open immersion and prove the projection equation.

Use the exact derived open restriction comparison and derived pullback composition from lem-pc-affine-derived-pullback-tensor-tilde. Whisker their composite with homology and residue-field sections. Use the explicit computation rule for the local functor; it is kept irreducible to avoid repeated unfolding.
